interface.description: Network interface to capture traffic from (e.g., eth0, enp0s3). Must have CAP_NET_RAW or root privileges.

log_dir.description: Directory where log files are written (e.g., /var/log/httpry). Ensure write permissions for the daemon user.

debug.description: Enable debug mode (implies verbose, outputs very detailed packet-level info). Use only for debugging.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of concurrent HTTP connections to track. Higher values use more memory.

timeout.description: Seconds of inactivity before a connection is considered idle and removed from tracking.

exclude_hosts.description: List of hostnames or IP addresses to ignore (no logging for traffic to/from them).

items.description: Hostname or IP address to exclude

log_requests.description: Log HTTP request lines (method, URI, version).

log_responses.description: Log HTTP response status lines (status code, reason phrase).

log_bodies.description: Log HTTP request/response bodies (enables full-text capture — use with care for privacy).

log_cookies.description: Log HTTP cookies (may include sensitive session data).

log_user_agents.description: Log HTTP User-Agent strings (used for client fingerprinting).

log_referer.description: Log HTTP Referer headers (tracks navigation sources).

plaintext_cookies.description: Log cookies in plaintext instead of masking. NOT RECOMMENDED in multi-tenant or untrusted environments.

user.description: System user to drop privileges to after startup (must exist on system).

group.description: System group to drop privileges to after startup (must exist on system).

daemonize.description: Run as a background daemon (true) or foreground (false, e.g., for systemd managed services).

pid_file.description: Path to the PID file written by the daemon.
